_about: The production baseline (pipeline/src/baseline.mjs): what of production's customisations every scratch org gets, so features are built against what production really has. All of production by default; exclude what cannot or must not reach a scratch org. Members are filtered: namespaced (managed) members are dropped, and the customisedOnly types keep only what a person changed after the org was created.
_watch_note: Listed only, never copied: what production has of these appears in the drift PR and the prod-baseline run summary ("Production has, scratch orgs don't"). Each needs something a scratch org does not get from production's shape: Entitlements and Territory Management enabled by a person, the Translation Workbench, an Experience Cloud domain and licences, an Email Services address. Enable the feature in the scratch definition, then move the type to types.
_standard_value_sets: StandardValueSet is not here: production cannot list it (Salesforce only retrieves standard value sets by name), so a picklist value added to a standard field (Lead Source, Industry) is not copied. Name the ones you change in a story's force-app.
_types_note: Approval processes, assignment, auto-response and escalation rules name production users: those become the scratch org's admin (baseline.sanitize), so the automation runs and routes somewhere real.
_exclude_note: Type, or Type:Name with * wildcards. Pipeline_CI is the pipeline's own CI permission set (devhub-setup, written by the skill's make-ci-cert.sh). Add your org's own exclusions here.
